title: Reaction Mechanism and Chemoselectivity of an Enzymatic PAS Domain: A Combined MD and QM/MM Study.
authors: Xiang, Sijie; Sheng, Xiang; Su, Hao
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD和QM/MM模拟研究PAS结构域酶催化N-脱甲基反应机制，虽以酶催化反应为核心而非蛋白质结构计算本身，但涉及蛋白环境对化学选择性的结构-功能关系解析，方法可迁移至蛋白质结构相关计算研究。
abstract: A Per-ARNT-Sim (PAS) domain exhibits oxidative N-demethylation activity toward dimethylamine (DMA); however, the detailed reaction mechanism remains elusive, thus hindering the rational engineering of the enzyme. In this work, we conducted molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and quantum mechanical/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) calculations to investigate the PAS domain-catalyzed DMA N-demethylation reaction. Our results indicate that the protonated substrate DMA is the most plausible proton donor during the formation of compound I (Cpd I, iron(IV)-oxo porphyrin cation radical). The calculated energy barrier for Cpd I generation is 14.4 kcal/mol, which is the rate-determining step of the reaction. Following its generation, Cpd I can rapidly oxidize the substrate via an electron-transfer-initiated hydrogen atom abstraction. The chemoselectivity favoring methyl hydroxylation over amine oxidation is mainly determined by the protein environment. Our computations provide mechanistic insights into the heme-dependent oxidative N-demethylase (HODM)-catalyzed reaction and offer information for the rational design of new PAS enzymes.
abstract_zh: 一个Per-ARNT-Sim（PAS）结构域对二甲胺（DMA）表现出氧化性N-脱甲基活性；然而，详细的反应机制仍不明确，从而阻碍了该酶的理性工程改造。在本工作中，我们进行了分子动力学（MD）模拟和量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）计算，以研究PAS结构域催化的DMA N-脱甲基反应。我们的结果表明，质子化的底物DMA是化合物I（Cpd I，铁(IV)-氧代卟啉阳离子自由基）形成过程中最可能的质子供体。计算得到的Cpd I生成能垒为14.4 kcal/mol，这是反应的速率决定步骤。在其生成后，Cpd I可通过电子转移引发的氢原子抽象快速氧化底物。有利于甲基羟基化而非胺氧化的化学选择性主要由蛋白质环境决定。我们的计算为血红素依赖性氧化性N-脱甲基酶（HODM）催化的反应提供了机制见解，并为新型PAS酶的理性设计提供了信息。
